name: CyDecompilator
description: AI assisted multi-engine decompiler: native code (Ghidra, own x86/x64 C decompiler, built-in disassembler), .NET (ILSpy), Java (Vineflower), Android (JADX), Python bytecode and shaders (own DXBC/SPIR-V/DXIL engine), with an assistant that explains, renames and converts pseudo-code into real code.
author: Cyberalien

operations.name: Prepare function patch
operations.description: Compile a native x86/x64 PE replacement. Default mode verifies a leaf function in place; extended mode appends linked code/data, resolves existing functions/imports, merges x64 unwind tables and ASLR relocations, and redirects the original entry. Preserve the original signature/ABI.
